scope: Preview-only permanent cross-product engineering verification tooling and organization roadmap. No runtime execution permissions, provider calls, billing or credentials changed.
riskAnalysis: Prevent false readiness, unreviewed authority changes, stale or incomplete change plans, hidden contract assumptions and sensitive telemetry exposure. Scope was reviewed before implementation; final Git binding is recorded after tests, not claimed as a timestamp proof.

threatModel.assets: Immutable evidence, source history, reservations, disabled paid execution, independent QA/security authority and protected Preview credentials.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Declarative change plans versus actual Git bytes; model/caller claims versus trusted backend state; offline counters versus authoritative telemetry; Engineering versus independent review identities.
threatModel.abuseCases: Downgrade risk, omit mandatory checks, hide code in multi-commit changes, run plan-supplied commands, forge readiness or reviewer identities, promote failed work, expose raw errors or waive uncertain holds.
threatModel.mitigations: Conservative raise-only floors, per-commit old/new blob binding, explicit history and clean-tree gate, fixed offline child commands, separate acceptance dimensions, bounded alert codes; trusted reviewer store/runtime attestation remains explicitly unimplemented.

rollback: Revert only this reviewed feature implementation after checking unrelated work; no generic destructive rollback, Production deployment or historical record alteration. Existing contract-first release remains unchanged.

negativePaths.malformed-response: New malformed plan/telemetry cases and unchanged contract-first frozen Chief/observation failure regressions; no provider repair.
negativePaths.stale-state: Old/new blob digest and readiness source mismatch regressions, stale telemetry; unchanged Chief v2 concurrency tests.
negativePaths.concurrency: Each feature commit is separately bound, stale plan cannot validate new bytes; runtime atomic task/Redis concurrency tests retained unchanged.
negativePaths.cancellation: No new executor introduced; existing cancelled-task and acceptance invalidation regressions retained in mandatory contract gate.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker changes; existing interruption/lease/diagnostic tests retain uncertain holds. Future active monitor and executor recovery remain separately gated.
negativePaths.api-outage: Offline unknown/unavailable dependency and API failure counters; no active external probe or model request.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: QA/Chief/Auditor role, execution identity and source binding negative tests; exact-source Preview unauthorized requests verified after publication.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Bounded counter, near/exhausted allowance and uncertain-hold alerts; no changes to reservation enforcement or historical accounting.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Missing readiness dimensions stay unverified, no mock-to-live promotion; existing five-stage rejected/bad adjudication/final-report mocks retained.

defects.rootCause: Prior Chief task/global revision namespaces and observation constraints diverged between model contract and backend validation.
defects.detectionGap: Backend-aware mocks supplied values absent from actual requests; green security/regression checks were mistaken for complete interface and live accuracy evidence.
defects.regression: Preserved tests/agent-operations-contract-first.test.js plus immutable tests/fixtures/agent-operations-contracts manifest and original raw failure replays.
defects.historicalPrevention: Both frozen historical outbound shapes fail unchanged mandatory pre-dispatch contract gate with zero provider fetches. No new paid rerun or duplicate investigation.
